description:
The upstream pi-mono TUI does not clear the screen on first render — it assumes a clean terminal and skips the clear entirely.

Change: In renderer.ex, initialize needs_clear to false so the first render calls full_render(lines, cursor_seq, state, false) instead of full_render(lines, cursor_seq, state, true).

Effect: Removes the \e[2J\e[H\e[3J escape sequence from the first render output, matching upstream behavior.

Files changed:
- apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/renderer.ex (init/1: needs_clear default)
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/renderer_test.exs (update test assertion)
title: Stop clearing screen on first render (match upstream)
